BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to disclosures of semen donation; adding a newsection to chapter 70.54 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.54 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any entity that operates as a sperm bank shall: (a) Require any donor to the bank to disclose how many times he hasdonated semen to sperm banks; and (b) Disclose to any recipient of semen: (i) The number of times the donor has reported having donated semento any sperm banks; (ii) The number of times the sperm bank has delivered semen fromthe donor to any recipient; and (iii) If known, the number of times that the semen from the donorhas resulted in successful insemination leading to a pregnancy. (2) A sperm bank that violates subsection (1)(b) of this sectionmay be liable under RCW 7.70.050 for the failure to secure informedconsent if the recipient demonstrates that the information identified p. 1 HB 2409in subsection (1)(b) of this section was a material fact relating tothe treatment and establishes all other necessary elements of proofunder RCW 7.70.050. (3) For the purposes of this section, "sperm bank" means anyfacility or program such as a person, hospital, clinic, corporation, orpartnership that is involved in procuring, furnishing, donating,processing, storing, or distributing human semen for the purpose ofartificial insemination.
